tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search Swiss apartments and houses for rent or sale. Supports city filtering (Zürich, Bern, Basel, Geneva), price (CHF), rooms, and square meters. EXAMPLES: "apartments in Zurich under 2000", "3-room flat in Bern", "house to buy in Basel".

address_city.description: Swiss city name. Examples: "Zürich", "Bern", "Basel", "Geneva", "Lausanne". Supports partial matching.

property_category.description: Category slug or array of slugs: "apartment", "house", "adjoining-rooms", "parking-lot", "trade-industry". Defaults to residential categories.

property_type.description: Property type or array of types: "apartment", "house", "studio", "commercial". Empty for all.

availability_type.description: "long_term" for permanent rentals, "short_term" for vacation rentals. Empty for all.

min_rent_monthly_price.description: Minimum monthly rent for rental properties in CHF

max_rent_monthly_price.description: Maximum monthly rent for rental properties in CHF

bounds.description: Geographic bounding box: {north, south, east, west}

tools.name: get_listing_detail
tools.description: Get full details for a specific property by ID. Returns amenities, pricing breakdown, contact info, images.

tools.name: get_similar_listings
tools.description: Return listings similar to a given property (same area/category).

tools.name: get_popular_listings
tools.description: Fetch the most popular/trending Swiss property listings.

tools.name: get_reserved_ranges
tools.description: Check availability/booking dates for a specific property. Returns blocked date ranges.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Immoswipe blog/guide articles about Swiss housing: renting tips, expat relocation guides, buying advice, deposits, tenancy law. Use for "how to" / advice questions. Returns titles, slugs and links; use get_guide to read the full article.

query.description: Optional keyword to filter articles by title/preview

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read the full Markdown text of a specific Immoswipe guide/blog article by slug (get the slug from search_guides).

slug.description: Article slug, e.g. "expat-guide-switzerland". Numeric ID also works.

tools.name: get_faqs
tools.description: Get Immoswipe FAQs about using the platform, renting, listing a property, photography/tour services and pricing.

tools.name: check_rental_chances
tools.description: Wohnungs-Chancen-Check for Swiss tenants: rates chances on the rental market (tenant score 0–100) from a search profile using real BFS vacancy, rent and ZKB market data, and suggests better alternative regions. Use for "how are my chances of finding a 3.5-room flat in Zürich for 2200". Afterwards the tenant can register in the pool via join_tenant_pool.

location.description: Desired place/region, e.g. "Zürich". Free text, geocoded server-side.

income.description: Optional gross annual income (improves tax estimate)

workplace_address.description: Optional workplace address for a commute estimate

search_radius_km.description: Optional search radius around the location in km, e.g. 15

tools.name: join_tenant_pool
tools.description: Register a Swiss tenant in the Immoswipe Mieter-Pool so property managers see their search profile and contact them about matching units. WRITE operation with personal data: ONLY call after the user has EXPLICITLY agreed to join the pool. consent must be true. Typical flow: run check_rental_chances first, then offer the sign-up.

last_name.description: Optional last name (derived from name if omitted)

search_radius_km.description: Optional search radius around the location in km, e.g. 15

preferences.description: Optional amenity wishes from the conversation. Lowercase English feature keys: "balcony", "terrace", "dishwasher", "washing machine", "garage", "parking", "elevator", "garden", "view", "pets allowed", "wheelchair access", "new building", "old building", "quiet location", "floor heating", "air conditioner", "storage room", "fitness center", "swimming pool", "free wifi". exclude also accepts "ground_floor", "basement", "attic".

must_have.description: Hard requirements — a unit lacking any of them is not matched

nice_to_have.description: Soft wishes — raise the match score, never exclude

exclude.description: Deal breakers — a unit with any of them is filtered out

consent.description: Must be true. Only set after the user explicitly agreed to join the Mieter-Pool, having been told that property managers will see their profile AND that an Immoswipe account is created as part of the sign-up.

locale.description: Language of the confirmation and verification emails

tools.name: get_pool_stats
tools.description: Public counters for the Immoswipe Mieter-Pool: how many tenants are registered and how many Chancen-Checks have been run. Aggregate numbers only, no personal data. Use to show a tenant the pool size before offering the sign-up via join_tenant_pool.
